Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. Procurement asked me to send a consolidated list of what they need to open an internal purchase request and to understand the invoicing cadence (monthly vs. upfront committed). - We can support monthly invoicing for committed Dedicated capacity (we'll surface an invoice schedule in the contract)
- SOC 2 evidence requests should be routed to security+compliance; I can provide the SOC2 summary and the contact for a full evidence request
- I attached a procurement checklist and our SKU mapping CSV to this email for review

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal ticket at Orion Procurement with attached checklist + SKU mapping (you)
2) Redwood and Google partner ops sync on any co-sell booking requirements (we suggest a 30-min sync this week)
3) Once procurement confirms billing cadence, Rishi will kick off the quote + contract draft and share a DocuSign link

I'll paste the attachments below and open a HubSpot deal activity referencing RDW-GCP-2025-089.

Thanks,

- Annual prepay: 10% discount; invoice up front.
